patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all pro/premium features by bypassing purchase validation and SharedPreferences checks.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Unlocks Ilqfk Plus features without a subscription, including the Plus shop items, extra themes and customization, seasonal event tiers, the monthly recap, and Plus insights. It also clears the upgrade prompts. Cloud backup and cross-device sync run on Ilqfk's own servers and still need the real subscription. Re-signing breaks Google sign-in, so log in with email instead.
